√tvakṣ 'fashion'
present: [2.] tvakṣāṇá -- [1.] tvakṣati 
[perfect: tatvakṣa atvakṣīt tvakṣiṣyati tvakṣitā tvaṣṭā ]
derivatives: -tvákṣaṇa tvákṣas RV. tvákṣīyas RV. tvaṣṭi C. tváṣṭṛ V.+ 
Compare √takṣ.
√tvac 'cover'\nSuch a root is assumed by some for tvác V.+ 'skin', and ātúc RV. 'dimness'.

√tvar 'hasten'
present: [1.] tvárate etc. B.+ tvárati etc. E.+ 
perfect: tatvare E.+ 
aorist: [3.] atitvarat atatvarat -- [5.] atvariṣṭa 
[future: tvaiṣyate tvaritā ]
verbal: tvarita E.+ 
secondary: intensive: tātvarya- totur- -- desiderative: titvariṣa- -- causative: tvaráyati etc. AV.+ tvaráyate etc. tvaryate tvāraya- 
derivatives: tvara tvarā S.+ tvaraṇá AV. tvaraṇīya E. 
A secondary root-form from √tṛ, tur, under which are here placed the derivatives with tūr- (tūrta, tūrti, tūrṇa).
